executionChain: Identity -> Authority -> Intent -> Capability -> Relationship -> Event -> Evidence -> State -> Value
strictInvariants: No consequential state mutation may bypass the canonical event and authority-validation gate.
Canonical events are typed, attributable, validated, idempotency-aware, and durably recorded with their resulting state transition.
Supabase may be a live-state substrate; it does not redefine canonical semantics.
GitHub is the source of repository implementation truth, while canonical meaning remains governed by HAPI World Canon and Carbon Actual contracts.
External adapters such as Zapier must never bypass the authenticated API or Edge validation gate.
ABBA may reason, plan, compose, route, and request authorization; ABBA cannot self-authorize or bypass policy.
Pulse is measurement/feedback and must not silently become currency, authority, permission, ownership, or factual evidence.
Tokenization, minting, decimalization, and fractionalization do not create underlying ownership, authority, truth, or value by themselves.
Historical material remains traceable and cannot become current authority by chronology alone.
ABBA continuation never bypasses the authority/policy boundary, even when choose-all-and-continue is selected.
corePrinciples: ABBA is the master intelligence and orchestrator across ecosystem domains and runtimes.
ABBA cannot manufacture authority, override constitutional law, or self-authorize consequential execution.
Capability does not imply permission or authority; policy and authority gates remain independent of orchestration.
Agent lifecycle, workflow composition, telemetry synthesis, and economic feedback are coordinated through ABBA while durable state remains governed by canonical contracts.
Every consequential execution is attributable, policy-gated, idempotency-aware, evidentiary, and reconstructable.
Runtime telemetry is observability input; it does not automatically become truth, evidence, Pulse, Value, authority, or permission.
ABBA must continue or explicitly stop governed work and retain a traceable reason for the terminal condition.

feedbackLoop.path: signal -> validation -> observation -> synthesis -> proposal -> authority/policy gate -> execution -> evidence -> feedback
feedbackLoop.rule: ABBA may aggregate ecosystem telemetry and coordinate adaptive responses without becoming the sole source of truth or bypassing domain authority.
